notes: ACCESS: reached entirely via Claude-in-Chrome, no curl/proxy. robots.txt (https://www.harrods.com/robots.txt) lists ClaudeBot under 'Targeted Bot Restrictions' with Crawl-delay:10 and Disallow:/*?*=* only (query-string/search filter URLs) -- no blanket disallow, so extraction proceeded; all URLs used are clean paths with no query string. TREE SOURCE: the /en-gb/c/departments/home-and-furniture hub is a thin marketing landing page with no real sub-nav, so the tree was built from (1) the site's own in-page category chip strips on /en-gb/furniture and each child PLP (found via DOM anchor scan, stripping query strings to avoid the connector's cookie/query redaction filter), and (2) a MANDATORY sitemap cross-check of https://www.harrods.com/en-gb/sitemap-categories.xml filtered for the substring 'furniture', which surfaced two branches the in-page nav did not link from the Furniture hub: a separate Outdoor department's own 'Furniture' node (/en-gb/outdoor/furniture, distinct URL and count from Furniture>Garden Furniture) and a Baby/Nursery Furniture department (/en-gb/baby-furniture/*). Site is Nuxt3/SCAYLE-commerce; every PLP embeds a __NUXT_DATA__ SSR payload (index-referenced array) containing the exact listing API response as {results, totalResults, ...}. QTY METHOD: totalResults was extracted from __NUXT_DATA__ for every leaf and cross-checked against the rendered 'N Results' header where visible (e.g. Garden Furniture: header '129 Results' = NUXT totalResults 129) -- they agreed everywhere checked. IMPORTANT CAVET DISCOVERED: the count shown in parentheses on a PARENT page's own child-chip strip (e.g. Furniture page showing 'Garden Furniture (161)', 'Dressing Tables (7)', 'Bedside Tables (6)') is NOT reliable -- it disagreed with the true per-node totalResults on 4 of the ~26 nodes checked (Garden Furniture true=129 not 161; Dressing Tables true=11 not 7; Bedside Tables true=9 not 6). Every qty in this file therefore comes from the CHILD leaf page's own NUXT totalResults / rendered header, never from a parent's chip count. STRUCTURE WALKED: Furniture hub (/en-gb/furniture) has 6 top children: Tables, Sofas & Armchairs, Beds, Chairs & Stools, Storage & Shelving, Garden Furniture. Tables/Sofas & Armchairs/Beds/Chairs & Stools/Storage & Shelving each expand one level further (own chip strips, confirmed via DOM scan); Garden Furniture has no further children (its own chip strip showed only generic cross-department links to Tables/Sofas & Armchairs/Chairs & Stools with unrelated small counts -- confirmed via sitemap that no furniture/garden-furniture/* URLs exist -- so it is recorded as a leaf itself). EXCLUSIONS: furniture/beds/mattresses (32) dropped -- mattresses are bedding not furniture per scope. furniture/storage-shelving/cabinets-safes (11) KEPT but flagged: title-scanned all 11 tiles -- 9 are genuine cabinet/dresser furniture (Multimedia Cabinet, Low Cabinet, Tall Cabinet, Valet Stand, Dresser, Display Cabinet, Kitchen Island Cabinet, Outdoor Island Cabinet, Piuma Cabinet) but 2 are watch-winder/jewellery safes (not furniture) -- site's own total kept per node with a flag rather than guessing a split. baby-furniture/cot-mobiles (12) dropped -- a hanging nursery toy/mobile, not furniture. baby-furniture/cribs-moses-baskets (19) KEPT but flagged ambiguous -- cribs are furniture, Moses baskets are portable baskets/bassinets with no facet to isolate them; site provides no split. sale/home-furniture excluded per standing rule (never extract sale/clearance as a category). Outdoor department's 'Cooking & Dining' (h1 'Cooking & Dining', BBQs/grills/outdoor tableware) inspected and confirmed non-furniture, not extracted. NOTE ON DUPLICATE-LOOKING NODES: Furniture>Garden Furniture (129 items, /en-gb/furniture/garden-furniture) and the separate Outdoor department's own Furniture node (84 items, /en-gb/outdoor/furniture, h1 'Outdoor Furniture') are two genuinely different site URLs/listing pages with different totals -- both kept as distinct rows per the 'keep both, explain in notes' rule; likely overlapping but not identical outdoor-furniture assortments (the site itself files them under two different departments: Furniture and Outdoor).
